Kleros is a decentralized dispute resolution protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Kleros relies on crowdsourced jurors who stake PNK tokens to participate in case voting. Kleros rewards jurors whose votes align with the majority outcome and penalizes those who vote incoherently.

Omen is a prediction market application built on smart contracts. Omen uses Gnosis Conditional Tokens as its underlying framework for market positions. Omen allows users to trade outcome tokens on the results of real-world events.

Aragon is a framework for creating and managing decentralized autonomous organizations on the Ethereum blockchain. Aragon enables groups to govern shared funds and decisions through on-chain voting. Aragon uses the ANT token as part of its network governance.

Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that delivers off-chain data to smart contracts on public blockchains. Chainlink aggregates data from multiple independent node operators to improve reliability. Chainlink uses the LINK token to pay node operators for their services.

Moloch DAO is a decentralized autonomous organization that funds public goods in the Ethereum ecosystem. Moloch DAO operates on the Moloch smart contract framework. Moloch DAO allows members to exit with their proportional share of funds through a ragequit mechanism.
